provenance.paper_title: Mobile-Agent-V: A Video-Guided Approach for Effortless and Efficient Operational Knowledge Injection in Mobile Automation

evidence.section: Full paper: 4.4.4 Impact of Knowledge Injection Method
evidence.paraphrase: Recorded task videos provide retained operational evidence for mobile automation.

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: A video agent extracts operational guidance that is reused during task execution.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 6): A fixed demonstration video and its extracted guidance are consumed during execution. Sliding windows and ordinary action history do not constitute persistent memory updates. No persistent inference-time T2 update or deployment-feedback policy evolution was found.
